contract.positiveSubset: Explicit single-type Spring import; no unresolved scopes; private final unannotated field allocated exactly with new JdbcTemplate(); known T01 context; supported standalone String literal API/SQL.
contract.bindingPremise: Authentic Spring declaration/API on classpath; no runtime binary qualification.
contract.dispatchEvidence: Exact allocation and private final reference; no reliance on static injected type or closed-world subtype absence.
contract.validator: One shared rule plus parse-only source snapshot reconstruction; existing T01 bindingEvidence decorations checked separately.

rootCause.R1: Omitted member subtype and override; producer assigned a library target without complete pertinent scope evidence.
rootCause.R2: Import map overrode lexical type parameter; non-Spring bound ApplicationJdbc became Spring in facts.
rootCause.validatorGap: Reclassification of producer facts repeated both omissions; T02 projected false T01 authority.
rootCause.fix: Lexical scope refusal and positive exact allocation; validators reparse source bytes and reject fabricated facts.

from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); out=Path(Path('/private/tmp/mana-d02-f02-current').read_text()); checks=[]
commands=[['python3','tests/'+n+'.py','-v'] for n in ['transaction-boundaries','transaction-self-invocation','transaction-context-alternatives','transaction-physical-lifetime','transaction-transition-contract','transaction-aop-causal-order','mana-skill-factory','resource-timeline','transaction-resource-leaves','transaction-resource-dispatch']]
files=['scripts/mana-transaction.py','scripts/mana-resource-timeline.py','scripts/skill_factory/transactions/model.py','scripts/skill_factory/transactions/source.py','scripts/skill_factory/transactions/resource_leaf.py','scripts/skill_factory/transactions/resources.py','scripts/skill_factory/transactions/plantuml.py','tests/transaction-resource-leaves.py','tests/transaction-resource-dispatch.py','tests/transaction-resource-binding.py','tests/resource-timeline.py']

for i,command in enumerate(commands):
 start=time.monotonic();r=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True);log=r.stdout+r.stderr; path=out/f'final-check-{i+1}.log';path.write_bytes(log);m=re.search(rb'Ran (\d+) tests?',log)
 checks.append({'command':command,'exit':r.returncode,'testsRun':int(m[1]) if m else None,'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-start,2),'log':str(path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(log).hexdigest()});(out/'final-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(checks,indent=2));print(command[:2],r.returncode,flush=True)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('binding_tests',root/'tests/transaction-resource-binding.py'); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
with (out/'binding-check.log').open('w') as log:
 r=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=log,verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(mod))
artifact={'testsRun':r.testsRun,'failures':len(r.failures),'errors':len(r.errors),'skipped':len(r.skipped),'exit':0 if r.wasSuccessful() else 1,'oracleResults':mod.BindingTests.oracle_results,'reports':mod.BindingTests.reports,'cases':{n:{'source':s,'expectedLeaves':e} for n,(s,e) in mod.CASES.items()}}
(out/'binding-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(artifact,indent=2));print('binding',artifact['exit'],flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
ROOT=Path('/Users/zel/projects/mana'); OUT=Path(Path('/private/tmp/mana-d02-f02-current').read_text())
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('resource_cli',ROOT/'scripts/mana-resource-timeline.py'); cli=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(cli)
OLD=Path('/private/tmp/mana-d02-f01-6_cchm7t/replay-sources')
cases=[('required-two','fixture.Operations#sequence()',['P1','P1'],2),('required-three','fixture.Operations#sequence()',['P1','P1','P1'],3),('requires-new','fixture.Entry#independent()',['P2'],1),('nested','fixture.Entry#nested()',['P1'],1),('restored','fixture.Entry#afterIndependent()',['P1'],1),('terminated','fixture.Entry#afterTerminated()',[None],1),('unresolved-order','fixture.Operations#sequence()',[None,None],0),('unknown-context','fixture.Operations#required()',[None],0),('async','fixture.Entry#async()',[None],0),('programmatic-fixture','fixture.Operations#sequence()',[None,None],0)]
def snapshot(p):
 return {str(f.relative_to(p)):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in p.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
results=[]
for name,entry,expected_ids,expected_leaves in cases:
 project=OLD/name; before=snapshot(project); context=json.loads((project/'context.json').read_text());context['resourceLeafPolicy']='JDBC_LITERAL_V1';path=OUT/(name+'-context.json');path.write_text(json.dumps(context)); report=cli.analyze(project,path,entry)
 ops=[o for o in report['observations'] if o['applicationOperation']['receiver']=='jdbc'];ids=[o['transactionContext']['physicalId'] for o in ops];leaves=[e for e in report['transactionModel']['events'] if e['kind']=='RESOURCE_LEAF_CALL'];unchanged=before==snapshot(project);assert unchanged
 match=ids==expected_ids and len(leaves)==expected_leaves
 # New literal contract expectation, independent of classify(): injected references never certify.
 assert leaves==[]
 assert all(o['placement']['status'] in {'T01_FRONTIER','UNPLACED'} for o in ops)
 if name=='required-two': assert ids==['P1',None]
 if name=='required-three': assert ids==['P1',None,None]
 assert all(o['enlistment']==o['lockAcquired']=='UNKNOWN' and o['datasource']=={'status':'UNKNOWN','id':None} for o in report['observations'])
 artifact=OUT/(name+'-replay.json');artifact.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
 results.append({'case':name,'entry':entry,'project':str(project),'historicalExpectedIds':expected_ids,'historicalExpectedLeaves':expected_leaves,'actualIds':ids,'actualLeaves':len(leaves),'historicalExpectation':'PASS' if match else 'DEGRADED','newContract':'PASS','sourceUnchanged':unchanged,'placement':[o['placement'] for o in ops],'artifact':str(artifact),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
r1=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/reports/MANA-TRANSACTION-01-T02-S01-R1-results.json').read_text())['counterexampleFullReport'];original=copy.deepcopy(r1);cli.validate_timeline(r1);assert r1==original
legacy=cli.analyze(OLD/'required-two',OLD/'required-two/context.json','fixture.Operations#sequence()');assert legacy['transactionModel']==r1['transactionModel'];assert legacy['observations']==r1['observations'];assert legacy['timeline']==r1['timeline'];results.append({'case':'R1 legacy replay and immutable historical report','historicalExpectation':'PASS','newContract':'PASS'})
# Use a genuinely certified rule-2 positive to exercise the pre-D02 rejection.
report=json.loads((OUT/'binding-results.json').read_text())['reports']['import_allocation'];legacy_module={'__name__':'skill_factory.transactions.legacy_model','__package__':'skill_factory.transactions'};old=Path('/private/tmp/mana-d02-f01-6_cchm7t/legacy/scripts/skill_factory/transactions/model.py');exec(compile(old.read_text(),'legacy_model.py','exec'),legacy_module)
try:
 legacy_module['validate_model'](report['transactionModel']);raise AssertionError('legacy validator accepted new event')
except ValueError as exc:
 assert str(exc)=='unrecognized transaction event',exc
results.append({'case':'Actual pre-D02 validator rejects new event','historicalExpectation':'PASS','newContract':'PASS','validatorSha256':hashlib.sha256(old.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
(OUT/'replay-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2));print(json.dumps({'total':len(results),'historicalPass':sum(r['historicalExpectation']=='PASS' for r in results),'degraded':sum(r['historicalExpectation']=='DEGRADED' for r in results),'newContractPass':sum(r['newContract']=='PASS' for r in results)}))
